sample.name: HR
sample.seed: npm run seed → oracle/db-sample-schemas human_resources (HR 스키마), 접속 계정 hr / SERVICE FREEPDB1

notes: Oracle 은 따옴표 없는 식별자를 대문자로 저장하므로 결과 key 가 대문자(EMPLOYEE_ID)로 온다. 판정은 대소문자를 구분하지 않는다.
스키마 파일 이름은 user_tables 기준 대문자 (tables/EMPLOYEES.md) — source 도 대문자

chat.question: 직원 목록 5명 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT * FROM employees FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

chat.question: 급여가 10000 이상인 직원 이름과 급여를 급여 높은 순으로 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT first_name, last_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary >= 10000 ORDER BY salary DESC

chat.question: 평균 급여보다 많이 받는 직원 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees)

chat.question: 직원 이름과 소속 부서명 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id

chat.question: Seattle 에 있는 부서 이름 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT d.department_name FROM locations l JOIN departments d ON d.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.city = 'Seattle'

chat.question: 직원 이름과 직무명 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, j.job_title FROM employees e JOIN jobs j ON j.job_id = e.job_id

chat.question: 부서별 부서장 이름 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT d.department_name, e.first_name, e.last_name FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = d.manager_id

chat.question: 부서명과 부서가 있는 도시, 국가 이름 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT d.department_name, l.city, c.country_name FROM departments d JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = d.location_id JOIN countries c ON c.country_id = l.country_id

chat.question: 직원 이름과 그 직원의 매니저 이름 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, m.first_name AS manager_first_name, m.last_name AS manager_last_name FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.employee_id = e.manager_id

chat.question: 직무 이력이 있는 직원의 이름, 시작일, 종료일, 직무 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, h.start_date, h.end_date, h.job_id FROM job_history h JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = h.employee_id

chat.question: 부서별 직원 수 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees GROUP BY department_id

chat.question: 부서별 평균 급여를 높은 순으로 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT d.department_name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id GROUP BY d.department_name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC

chat.question: 급여가 100만 이상인 직원 이름 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE salary >= 1000000

direct.sql: SELECT * FROM "EMPLOYEES" FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM hr.employees FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.salary FROM employees e FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT d.* FROM employees e JOIN departments d ON d.department_id = e.department_id FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT d.department_name, d.manager_id, e.first_name FROM departments d JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = d.manager_id
SELECT e.first_name AS given_name, j.job_title AS title FROM employees e JOIN jobs j ON j.job_id = e.job_id FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
SELECT l.city, c.country_name FROM locations l, countries c WHERE c.country_id = l.country_id
SELECT * FROM (SELECT employee_id, first_name, salary FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5
SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees GROUP BY department_id
SELECT first_name, salary FROM employees WHERE 1 = 0
WITH dept AS (SELECT department_id, department_name FROM departments) SELECT e.first_name, d.department_name FROM employees e JOIN dept d ON d.department_id = e.department_id FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
